description: Read hosted agent runs (/agent/run) for the account behind the current key. Use list for recent runs newest first, or get to open a run by its run_… ID. These are not MCP session IDs or browser session IDs. Read-only: never starts, continues, cancels or repeats a run. MCP Apps clients receive a viewRef to pass to browserless_show for the inline timeline when available. Show at most one run timeline per chat turn; summarize other requested runs in text and offer to open them in separate turns. Do not claim those runs were displayed inline.
name: browserless_agent_runs
